capabilities: Preview web links, notes, and PDFs in an overlay via Shift+click
Keep a preview as a regular tab preserving state and scroll position
Hide webpage elements with rules saved per site origin
Restore reading positions when reopening a link
Search inside previewed pages with Cmd/Ctrl+F
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not create floating OS windows; previews appear inside the main vault window and pop-out windows are not supported.
extras: Uses private Web viewer APIs and may need adjustments after Obsidian updates; not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; mobile and pop-out windows unsupported; tested only on macOS; Google sign-in returns 401 in the tested environment.
intentEvidence: Webpages load directly through Obsidian's Web viewer.
problem: Obsidian opens links in separate tabs or panes, pulling you away from the note; there is no Peek-style temporary overlay for previewing links without leaving context.

relations.evidence: Webpages load directly through Obsidian's Web viewer.

summary: Link-preview overlay that opens web pages, notes, or PDFs over the current note, can keep them as tabs, and hides webpage elements via saved per-site rules.
